parsed_json.sql: SELECT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action, drug_mechanism.action_type, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name AS target_name FROM molecule_dictionary JOIN drug_mechanism ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_mechanism.molregno JOIN target_dictionary ON drug_mechanism.tid = target_dictionary.tid JOIN compound_structures ON molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno WHERE molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4 AND drug_mechanism.action_type = 'INHIBITOR' ORDER BY molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.max_phase, drug_mechanism.mechanism_of_action, drug_mechanism.action_type, target_dictionary.chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name
